fejer_bubble.definition: Let q_m(t)=[sin(mt/2)/(m sin(t/2))]^2 be the normalized Fejer kernel, Q_m(x)=product_(j=1)^3 q_m(x_j), f_N=1-2Q_m and m=floor(N/sqrt(3))+1
fejer_bubble.bandlimit: Each q_m has one-dimensional degree m-1, so Q_m and f_N have Euclidean Fourier support |k|_2<=sqrt(3)(m-1)<=N
fejer_bubble.sign_geometry: The negative phase {Q_m>1/2} is a localized genuinely three-dimensional bubble of volume Theta(m^(-3)); f_N(0)=-1 and f_N is positive away from the bubble
fejer_bubble.lower_scale: On one fixed scaled box x_j in [1/m,2/m], compact sinc convergence keeps Q_m uniformly away from 0 and 1; its volume is Theta(m^(-3)), so delta_N=Omega(m^(-3))
fejer_bubble.shell_consequence: The total nonconstant sign energy is 4p_m(1-p_m)=Theta(m^(-3)); hence every fixed-ratio shell mass is O(N^(-3)) and vanishes
fejer_bubble.scope_guard: Sign change alone admits defect Theta(N^(-3)); this does not challenge K1549 because the localized sign bubble has vanishing, not nonvanishing, shell mass and supplies no order-N2 likelihood with K1541 covariance
